method.landing_force_window: after longest eight-link unloaded segment in 1.0..2.0s, through reference phase2.0s; unknown if truncated
method.limits: one seed, five nominal deterministic repeats, one randomized startup draw; drive torque excludes passive impact load; cumulative durations are not necessarily continuous
method.mirror_residual: (q_left+q_right)-(qref_left+qref_right), matching reward; four pair averages, scales0.1/0.2/0.2/0.2rad
method.nominal_velocity_limits: 20rad/s legs,10rad/s foot,33rad/s wheel, from saved actuator model; not hardware acceptance
method.reference_phase: control samples use commanded frame/fps; physics samples use frame/fps+(substep+1)*0.005
method.unloaded_definition: all four foot/wheel and four thigh/shank force norms below1N; excludes base/hip
